en.text: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶路·巴力的儿子亚比米勒到了示剑见他的众母舅，对他们和他外祖全家的人说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶路‧巴力的兒子亞比米勒到了示劍見他的眾母舅，對他們和他外祖全家的人說：

en.text: “Please speak in the ears of all the men of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that all the sons of Jerubbaal, who are seventy persons, rule over you, or that one rule over you?’ Remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.”

zhSimplified.text: 「请你们问示剑的众人说，是耶路·巴力的众子七十人都管理你们好呢？还是一人管理你们好呢？你们又要记念我是你们的骨肉。」

zhTraditional.text: 「請你們問示劍的眾人說，是耶路‧巴力的眾子七十人都管理你們好呢？還是一人管理你們好呢？你們又要記念我是你們的骨肉。」

en.text: His mother’s brothers spoke of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words. Their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, “He is our brother.”

zhSimplified.text: 他的众母舅便将这一切话为他说给示剑人听，示剑人的心就归向亚比米勒。他们说：「他原是我们的弟兄」；

zhTraditional.text: 他的眾母舅便將這一切話為他說給示劍人聽，示劍人的心就歸向亞比米勒。他們說：「他原是我們的弟兄」；

en.text: They gave him seventy pieces of silver out of the house of Baal Berith, with which Abimelech hired vain and reckless fellows who followed him.

zhSimplified.text: 就从巴力·比利土的庙中取了七十舍客勒银子给亚比米勒；亚比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 就從巴力‧比利土的廟中取了七十舍客勒銀子給亞比米勒；亞比米勒用以雇了些匪徒跟隨他。

en.text: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one stone; but Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left, for he hid himself.

zhSimplified.text: 他往俄弗拉到他父亲的家，将他弟兄、耶路·巴力的众子七十人都杀在一块磐石上；只剩下耶路·巴力的小儿子约坦，因为他躲藏了。

zhTraditional.text: 他往俄弗拉到他父親的家，將他弟兄、耶路‧巴力的眾子七十人都殺在一塊磐石上；只剩下耶路‧巴力的小兒子約坦，因為他躲藏了。

en.text: All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by the oak of the pillar that was in Shechem.

en.text: When they told it to Jotham, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim and lifted up his voice, cried out, and said to them, “Listen to me, you men of Shechem, that God may listen to you.

zhTraditional.text: 有人將這事告訴約坦，他就去站在基利心山頂上，向眾人大聲喊叫說：「示劍人哪，你們要聽我的話，上帝也就聽你們的話。

en.text: The trees set out to anoint a king over themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’

en.text: “But the olive tree said to them, ‘Should I stop producing my oil, with which they honor God and man by me, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

zhSimplified.text: 橄榄树回答说：『我岂肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飘摇在众树之上呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 橄欖樹回答說：『我豈肯止住供奉神和尊重人的油，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』

en.text: “The trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’

zhSimplified.text: 树木对无花果树说：『请你来作我们的王。』

zhTraditional.text: 樹木對無花果樹說：『請你來作我們的王。』

en.text: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

zhSimplified.text: 无花果树回答说：『我岂肯止住所结甜美的果子，飘摇在众树之上呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 無花果樹回答說：『我豈肯止住所結甜美的果子，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』

en.text: “The trees said to the vine, ‘Come and reign over us.’

zhSimplified.text: 树木对葡萄树说：『请你来作我们的王。』

zhTraditional.text: 樹木對葡萄樹說：『請你來作我們的王。』

en.text: “The vine said to them, ‘Should I leave my new wine, which cheers God and man, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’

zhSimplified.text: 葡萄树回答说：『我岂肯止住使神和人喜乐的新酒，飘摇在众树之上呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 葡萄樹回答說：『我豈肯止住使神和人喜樂的新酒，飄颻在眾樹之上呢？』

en.text: “Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’

zhSimplified.text: 众树对荆棘说：『请你来作我们的王。』

zhTraditional.text: 眾樹對荊棘說：『請你來作我們的王。』

en.text: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.’

zhSimplified.text: 荆棘回答说：『你们若诚诚实实地膏我为王，就要投在我的荫下；不然，愿火从荆棘里出来，烧灭黎巴嫩的香柏树。』

zhTraditional.text: 荊棘回答說：『你們若誠誠實實地膏我為王，就要投在我的蔭下；不然，願火從荊棘裏出來，燒滅黎巴嫩的香柏樹。』

en.text: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands

zhSimplified.text: 「现在你们立亚比米勒为王，若按诚实正直善待耶路·巴力和他的全家，这就是酬他的劳。

zhTraditional.text: 「現在你們立亞比米勒為王，若按誠實正直善待耶路‧巴力和他的全家，這就是酬他的勞。

en.text: (for my father fought for you, risked his life, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian;

zhSimplified.text: 从前我父冒死为你们争战，救了你们脱离米甸人的手。

zhTraditional.text: 從前我父冒死為你們爭戰，救了你們脫離米甸人的手。

en.text: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);

zhSimplified.text: 你们如今起来攻击我的父家，将他众子七十人杀在一块磐石上，又立他婢女所生的儿子亚比米勒为示剑人的王；他原是你们的弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 你們如今起來攻擊我的父家，將他眾子七十人殺在一塊磐石上，又立他婢女所生的兒子亞比米勒為示劍人的王；他原是你們的弟兄。

en.text: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;

zhSimplified.text: 你们如今若按诚实正直待耶路·巴力和他的家，就可因亚比米勒得欢乐，他也可因你们得欢乐；

en.text: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”

en.text: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

footnotes.text: 9:21 “Beer” is Hebrew for “well”, i.e., a village named for its well.

zhSimplified.text: 约坦因怕他弟兄亚比米勒，就逃跑，来到比珥，住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 約坦因怕他弟兄亞比米勒，就逃跑，來到比珥，住在那裏。

en.text: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.

zhSimplified.text: 亚比米勒管理以色列人三年。

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒管理以色列人三年。

en.text: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech,

en.text: that the violence done to the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come, and that their blood might be laid on Abimelech their brother who killed them, and on the men of Shechem who strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

en.text: The men of Shechem set an ambush for him on the tops of the mountains, and they robbed all who came along that way by them; and Abimelech was told about it.

en.text: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.

en.text: They went out into the field, harvested their vineyards, trod the grapes, celebrated, and went into the house of their god and ate and drank, and cursed Abimelech.

en.text: Gaal the son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Isn’t he the son of Jerubbaal? Isn’t Zebul his officer? Serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem, but why should we serve him?

zhSimplified.text: 以别的儿子迦勒说：「亚比米勒是谁？示剑是谁？使我们服事他呢？他不是耶路·巴力的儿子吗？他的帮手不是西布勒吗？你们可以服事示剑的父亲哈抹的后裔。我们为何服事亚比米勒呢？

en.text: I wish that this people were under my hand! Then I would remove Abimelech.” He said to Abimelech, “Increase your army and come out!”

en.text: Then Zebul said to him, “Now where is your mouth, that you said, ‘Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him?’ Isn’t this the people that you have despised? Please go out now and fight with them.”

zhSimplified.text: 西布勒对他说：「你曾说，亚比米勒是谁，叫我们服事他？你所夸的口在哪里呢？这不是你所藐视的民吗？你现在出去，与他们交战吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 西布勒對他說：「你曾說，亞比米勒是誰，叫我們服事他？你所誇的口在哪裏呢？這不是你所藐視的民嗎？你現在出去，與他們交戰吧！」

en.text: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

en.text: Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city and killed the people in it. He beat down the city and sowed it with salt.

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒整天攻打城，將城奪取，殺了其中的居民，將城拆毀，撒上了鹽。

en.text: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴亞比米勒說：「示劍樓的人都聚在一處。」

en.text: Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, he and all the people who were with him; and Abimelech took an ax in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it up, and laid it on his shoulder. Then he said to the people who were with him, “What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done!”

zhSimplified.text: 亚比米勒和跟随他的人就都上撒们山。亚比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根树枝，扛在肩上，对跟随他的人说：「你们看我所行的，也当赶紧照样行。」

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒和跟隨他的人就都上撒們山。亞比米勒手拿斧子，砍下一根樹枝，扛在肩上，對跟隨他的人說：「你們看我所行的，也當趕緊照樣行。」

en.text: All the people likewise each cut down his bough, followed Abimelech, and put them at the base of the stronghold, and set the stronghold on fire over them, so that all the people of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

zhSimplified.text: 众人就各砍一枝，跟随亚比米勒，把树枝堆在卫所的四围，放火烧了卫所，以致示剑楼的人都死了，男女约有一千。

zhTraditional.text: 眾人就各砍一枝，跟隨亞比米勒，把樹枝堆在衛所的四圍，放火燒了衛所，以致示劍樓的人都死了，男女約有一千。

en.text: Then Abimelech went to Thebez and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

zhSimplified.text: 亚比米勒到提备斯，向提备斯安营，就攻取了那城。

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒到提備斯，向提備斯安營，就攻取了那城。

en.text: But there was a strong tower within the city, and all the men and women of the city fled there, and shut themselves in, and went up to the roof of the tower.

zhSimplified.text: 城中有一座坚固的楼；城里的众人，无论男女，都逃进楼去，关上门，上了楼顶。

zhTraditional.text: 城中有一座堅固的樓；城裏的眾人，無論男女，都逃進樓去，關上門，上了樓頂。

en.text: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 亚比米勒到了楼前攻打，挨近楼门，要用火焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒到了樓前攻打，挨近樓門，要用火焚燒。

en.text: A certain woman cast an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, and broke his skull.

zhSimplified.text: 有一个妇人把一块上磨石抛在亚比米勒的头上，打破了他的脑骨。

zhTraditional.text: 有一個婦人把一塊上磨石拋在亞比米勒的頭上，打破了他的腦骨。

en.text: Then he called hastily to the young man, his armor bearer, and said to him, “Draw your sword and kill me, that men not say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’ His young man thrust him through, and he died.”

zhSimplified.text: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，对他说：「拔出你的刀来，杀了我吧！免得人议论我说，他为一个妇人所杀。」于是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。

zhTraditional.text: 他就急忙喊叫拿他兵器的少年人，對他說：「拔出你的刀來，殺了我吧！免得人議論我說，他為一個婦人所殺。」於是少年人把他刺透，他就死了。

en.text: When the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they each departed to his place.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人见亚比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人見亞比米勒死了，便各回自己的地方去了。

en.text: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;

zhSimplified.text: 这样， 神报应亚比米勒向他父亲所行的恶，就是杀了弟兄七十个人的恶。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣，上帝報應亞比米勒向他父親所行的惡，就是殺了弟兄七十個人的惡。

en.text: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.

zhSimplified.text: 示剑人的一切恶， 神也都报应在他们头上；耶路·巴力的儿子约坦的咒诅归到他们身上了。

zhTraditional.text: 示劍人的一切惡，上帝也都報應在他們頭上；耶路‧巴力的兒子約坦的咒詛歸到他們身上了。
